original_target.title: Holomorphic convexity of transport twistor spaces of Anosov surfaces

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "twistor" "holomorphic convexity" (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com)

sources.scope: Infinite-dimensional holomorphic algebra for Anosov case but leaves holomorphic convexity open. Flat torus and sphere cases differ.
Global blow-down for constant-curvature disks and nearby simple disks; local blow-down for any surface. Local coordinates do not prove global compact hulls for closed Anosov base.
Special circularly symmetric nontrapping disks; not closed Anosov surfaces.

registry_checks: No twistor alias Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI/Colbrook metadata; focused primary arXiv, author/publisher, Zenodo, HAL, GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Uses all interior holomorphic functions, no smooth boundary restriction; cannot infer negative answer from boundary-smooth algebra being constant. Neither rigidity classification nor local blow-down supplies universal hull compactness.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement.
